# sevalla_static_site_domain (Resource)

Manages a domain for a Sevalla static site.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Standard domain
resource "sevalla_static_site_domain" "example" {
  static_site_id = sevalla_static_site.example.id
  name           = "docs.example.com"
}

# Wildcard domain with custom SSL
resource "sevalla_static_site_domain" "wildcard" {
  static_site_id = sevalla_static_site.example.id
  name           = "example.com"
  is_wildcard    = true
  custom_ssl_cert = file("certs/example.com.pem")
  custom_ssl_key  = file("certs/example.com.key")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The domain name.
- `static_site_id` (String) The ID of the static site this domain belongs to.

### Optional

- `custom_ssl_cert` (String, Sensitive) Custom SSL certificate in PEM format, used instead of an auto-provisioned one. The API does not return it, so it is not checked for drift. Changing it creates a new domain, except after an import, when the configured value is only recorded.
- `custom_ssl_key` (String, Sensitive) Private key of the custom SSL certificate in PEM format. Required with `custom_ssl_cert`. Changing it creates a new domain, except after an import, when the configured value is only recorded.
- `is_wildcard` (Boolean) Whether the domain is a wildcard domain that matches all subdomains. Defaults to `false`. Changing this creates a new domain.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the domain was created.
- `dns_records` (String) JSON-encoded DNS records to create for the domain (e.g. `[{"type":"CNAME","name":"app.example.com","value":"..."}]`), or null when none are needed. Decode it with `jsondecode()`.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the domain.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the domain is enabled.
- `is_primary` (Boolean) Whether this is the primary domain.
- `status` (String) The verification status: `VERIFICATION`, `POINTING`, `ACTIVE` or `TIMED_OUT`.
- `type` (String) The domain type: `CUSTOM` for user-added domains or `SYSTEM` for platform-assigned ones.
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the domain was last updated.
